purpose: Make precedent lookup, task normalization, UI parity evidence, scope expansion, verification, and completion archival required engineering gates instead of optional assistant memory.

canonical_seams.policy: The profile is additive. It does not authorize a parallel queue, task protocol, scheduler, board, or doctrine store.

installation.uninstalled_boundary: No additional admitted mutating executor exists in the current inventory. Any future direct source-mutation launcher remains uninstalled until it proves the same fail-closed artifact chain.

lifecycle.single_source_rule: The canonical card is the queue projection. The correlated job envelope is the bounded execution identity. The engineering-memory profile is one additive gate profile inside that job, never a disconnected list.

precedent_lookup.no_match_phrase: No matching precedent found. Creating first durable pattern.
precedent_lookup.evidence_rule: Every searched source records a result and evidence refs. A reusable match that is not used requires an explicit rejection rationale.

parity.verification: Passed screenshot, DOM, or visual-diff evidence must cover the canonical source and every target surface.

visual_work.completion_rule: Unavailable evidence remains explicit and keeps the task implemented, partial, or blocked; it cannot be relabeled verified.

fast_lane.label: five-minute-patch-lane
fast_lane.promotion_rule: If scope or verification expands, change lane to normal and preserve the original parent acceptance criteria.

archive.no_change_runtime_exception: A runner-generated closeout under the bound run log is allowed only with validated no-change proof and never substitutes for a mutated workspace completion archive.

knowledge_seeds.title: Precedent Lookup Before Implementation
knowledge_seeds.statement: Before implementing a change, search the current repo and Atlas knowledge surfaces for the same or similar problem; reuse, adapt, reject with rationale, or declare the first durable pattern.

knowledge_seeds.title: Visual Work Requires Visual Evidence
knowledge_seeds.statement: Code inspection cannot close UI work; required routes and states need browser, device, DOM, screenshot, or visual-diff evidence at the bound revision.

knowledge_seeds.title: Do Not Fragment Task State
knowledge_seeds.statement: Every active item maps to one stable canonical card and correlated job; incidental lists never become independent truth sources.

knowledge_seeds.title: Shared Semantic Control
knowledge_seeds.statement: Repeated controls with the same product role use a shared component or shared style/token contract unless an intentional variant is documented and proven.

knowledge_seeds.title: PWA Standalone Safe-Area Layout
knowledge_seeds.statement: Browser and installed standalone modes share shell-owned viewport and safe-area contracts; standalone mode does not reserve phantom browser-toolbar space.

knowledge_seeds.title: Claimed Carryover Without Parity
knowledge_seeds.statement: An agent reports a visual pattern copied while source and target still differ; prevent closure until both surfaces have property-level, route-aware evidence.

knowledge_seeds.title: Expanding Task Erases Queue
knowledge_seeds.statement: A parent task silently absorbs discoveries and other queued work disappears; freeze parent scope and create linked child tasks.

knowledge_seeds.title: Atlas Is Enforcement, Not Memory Alone
knowledge_seeds.statement: Atlas does not rely on model recollection; it requires explicit lookup, application or rejection, proof, and archival at lifecycle boundaries.

knowledge_seeds.title: Workbox Strict Same-Origin Canonical Comparison
knowledge_seeds.statement: Canonicalize same-origin Workbox URL keys before exact comparison while preserving decoded-path safety, admitted query and fragment semantics, duplicate rejection, required coverage, byte count, and SHA-256 identity; never compare by basename.

knowledge_seeds.title: Workbox Raw URL Shape False Negative
knowledge_seeds.statement: Raw relative versus root-relative comparison can falsely reject equivalent same-origin Workbox entries and force a safe but unnecessary rollback.

knowledge_seeds.title: Vercel Immutable Binding No-Auto-Link Preflight
knowledge_seeds.statement: Before a linkage-capable Vercel CLI call, validate immutable workspace, project, organization or team, exact binding bytes, non-reparse path, and an installed explicit command-target profile; unknown or ambiguous surfaces fail closed before invocation.

knowledge_seeds.title: Vercel Unbound Diagnostic Auto-Link
knowledge_seeds.statement: An unbound diagnostic Vercel CLI command can mutate local linkage and create provider resources even when no deployment is intended.
